title: Casio Unisex 3H Watch MQ-24S-7BDF
description:
This watch feature a metallic case, sunburst-finish dial and band that come together in harmonized monochromatic color schemes.

A simple design with basic hour, minute and second hands, water resistance for daily use and a lightweight, comfortable fit for an easy, breezy timepiece.
features: Approx. battery life: 3 years on SR626SW
